summary: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 07:55 - v3.7.0 (commit 97ff7f4, pushed). Implemented the two crypto items flagged in the review. (1) ARGON2ID OFF-THREAD: deriveKek returned Promise.resolve(argon2id(...)) with a comment claiming it kept callers off the event loop - it does not, Promise.resolve wraps an already-computed value, so the full ~1.6s derivation stalled the background worker that also serves preview.get/capture/vault messages. crypto-vault now exposes a swappable KdfRunner via setKdfRunner (validates returned key length and passes options through untouched so a runner cannot silently weaken the KDF); src/lib/argon-worker.ts computes it in a Worker, src/lib/argon-kdf-host.ts installs it. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT: Worker is NOT exposed in Chrome MV3 service workers (only Firefox's event page), so the host probes typeof Worker and falls back to inline derivation - fallback is exactly the previous behaviour. New esbuild step emits dist/argon-worker.js. Argon2 params UNCHANGED (t=3 m=64MiB) - that cost is the only defense for a 4-digit PIN. (2) ENCRYPT WHILE LOCKED: wrapping the per-blob DEK only ever needed the ML-KEM public key, which is already stored in cleartext in VaultMaterial. Added encryptBlobWithPublicKey; encryptBlobWithUnlocked delegates to it for KEM modes so both paths emit identical envelopes. savePreviewBlob now accepts writes while locked (stored encrypted, unreadable until next unlock) instead of throwing - this removes the locked-vault preview-loss path patched earlier in v3.4.4. aes-only vaults still require unlock (no asymmetric key). 6 new tests in src/lib/crypto-vault-locked.test.ts. Verified tsc clean, vitest 34/34, build OK. User will test.
